finding.label: Is it real?
finding.prompt: Is this a real problem? Check it against the code.

finding.label: Draft the comment
finding.prompt: Draft the PR comment for this finding. Follow my note if I wrote one.

finding.label: Tests?
finding.prompt: Which test would catch this? Name the file and the case.

diff.label: Explain
diff.prompt: Explain what this code does and why it may have been written this way.

diff.label: Bugs?
diff.prompt: Check these lines for bugs, edge cases and anything that does not match the code around them.

diff.label: Too clever
diff.prompt: Is this more complex than it needs to be? Say what I would delete.

diff.label: Word the change
diff.prompt: Word a change request for the coding session about these lines. Follow my note if I wrote one.
